purpose: Define how an MCP-advertised tool becomes an AIGMos runtime tool through explicit identity mapping, schema validation and effect/authority declaration rather than blind import of remote metadata.

value.binding_rule: MCP tool advertisement must bind to an explicit local runtime tool identity or validated generated identity under a declared namespace.
value.schema_rule: Input/output schemas are validated before registration.
value.effect_rule: AIGMos-facing side effects/effect class are explicit locally and are not trusted solely from remote advertisement.
value.authority_rule: Remote metadata cannot grant local authority.
value.identity_rule: Remote tool name is not automatically the final local tool identity.
value.update_rule: Advertisement/schema change invalidates or revalidates the binding before continued use.
value.result_rule: Tool result remains inert data after invocation.

invariants.rule: MCP server identity, transport, tool schema, lifecycle and authority remain explicit and do not inherit trust from connectivity or advertised metadata.

tool result directly executes follow-up effect
